title: Offline fixture envelope (unified)
description: Versioned envelope for deterministic offline fixtures shared by Rust, Python, and TypeScript tests. This is test infrastructure: it never defines domain fields and always defers payload validation to the canonical schemas in packages/schemas. One canonical envelope covers the two historical variants (ADR-017): the 'contract' variant (W0-05: schema_version + contract + expected + stability.stable_fields, files named *.fixture.json) and the 'dataset' variant (TEST-01: fixture_envelope_version + kind + input.schema/payload + expected_outputs + stability.deterministic, files named fixture.json). A file uses exactly ONE variant: the offline validators (scripts/validate-fixture.py, scripts/check-contracts.ps1, tests/fixtures-support loaders) dispatch on the variant marker and enforce the variant-specific required fields, because the v1 validation vocabulary (packages/schemas/README.md rule 5) cannot express conditional requirements in-schema.

schema_version.description: Contract-variant marker (W0-05). Mutually exclusive with fixture_envelope_version.

fixture_envelope_version.description: Dataset-variant marker (TEST-01). Mutually exclusive with schema_version.

fixture_id.description: Globally unique identifier. Contract variant: '<dataset>.<case>' kebab-case, e.g. 'minimal.research-config-basic'. Dataset variant: kebab-case, equal to the directory name holding fixture.json.

contract.description: Contract variant: the canonical contract in packages/schemas that input (and expected) must satisfy.

schema.description: Contract name matching a packages/schemas/<name>.v<major>.json file stem.

schema_version.description: Major.minor of the embedded contract; the envelope loader resolves it to <name>.v<major>.json.

kind.description: Dataset variant: what the input payload is; equals the input schema $id base name without extension and version suffix, e.g. research-config.

prompt.description: Present when the expected output was produced by a prompt pipeline; the version participates in cache keys and golden case selection.

input.description: Contract variant: the payload instance itself. Dataset variant: closed block {schema, payload} where schema is a canonical $id from packages/schemas and payload must satisfy it. The variant-specific shape is enforced by the offline validators.

expected.description: Contract variant: golden expected output; omitted for input-only fixtures. Must satisfy the contract family when present.

expected_outputs.description: Dataset variant: golden results. Entries are added only after the corresponding output schema is frozen in packages/schemas; an explicitly empty array means outputs are pending.

provenance.description: Union of the variant provenance vocabularies; the variant-specific required keys (contract: kind; dataset: origin + synthetic) are enforced by the offline validators.

synthetic.description: Dataset variant: true means no captured provider output, no personal data, no private research content.

stability.description: Union of the variant stability vocabularies; the variant-specific required keys are enforced by the offline validators.

stable_fields.description: Contract variant: fields compared byte-for-byte in golden checks.

volatile_fields.description: Contract variant: fields normalized (dropped or placeholdered) before golden comparison.

deterministic.description: Dataset variant: false means the fixture contains volatile fields that comparisons must normalize first.

ignored_fields.description: Dataset variant: field paths excluded from golden comparisons.
